baseline_source: PDF to Audio/audio_book.py (captured before source edits)

public_inputs.user_prompt: Enter the page no from where you want to start:
public_inputs.accepted_input_shape: A string accepted by int(); the script does not validate positivity or PDF page bounds.
public_inputs.default_pdf_path: python_basics.pdf, opened relative to the process working directory in binary read mode.
public_inputs.callable_api: None; importing/executing the module immediately prompts and performs work.

result.function_return: None; no public function is defined.
observable_outputs: Queues extracted page text with pyttsx3 and waits for each utterance.

mutation_behavior.pdf: Opened read-only ('rb'); no PDF writes are issued.
mutation_behavior.other_state: Consumes one input response and initializes/uses a speech engine; the opened file is not explicitly closed.
mutation_behavior.invalid_input_baseline: The file is opened before int(input_value), so malformed input raises after opening the stream.

external_dependencies.filesystem: python_basics.pdf at the current working directory
external_dependencies.test_strategy: Mock the PDF path open, PyPDF2 reader, pyttsx3 engine, input, and stdout; execute only this module.

failure_probe.reason: int('') raises ValueError before PDF parsing or speech begins.
